description:
List minute and conversation bookings

Lists the bookings on your voice minutes, chat conversations and avatar minutes, newest first: grants, purchases, add-ons, usage, refunds and adjustments (`transactionType`), each with the amount and the balance after it. Use it to explain where credits went. For what is left now use `list_usage_pools`; for the euro balance and its movements use `get_balance` and `list_transactions`. Read only.

limit.description: Most rows returned, 1 to 200, newest first.

type.description: Only bookings of this credit type; all types when left out.

name: list_credit_history
title: List minute and conversation bookings
